text:
Things To Help With
House stuff
- Trash - Empty all trash and diaper pails to side of house, compost, recycling
- Laundry - Hampers in T&S's and Miri's room, wash, dry, fold
- Floors - Vacuum and/or swifter jet
- Kitchen - dishes, counters, etc
- Fridge cleanup - you have full permission to throw things away
- Walkway cleanup - clean the figs off
- Tidying public spaces - if you don't know where something goes, put it in a pile for Tal
- Watering plants
Miri Help
- Read books!
- Color with her
- Dance party
- Dress up
- Do "homework" activity books with Miri
- Play "School"
- Any or all of the morning tasks:
- Hang out with Miri and give her breakfast (starting at 7:30am)
- Prepare snacks for school
- Drive to school (Carl B Munck)
- Pick up from school
- Bedtime with Miri
- Take Miri for a few hours
- Preparing snacks for Miri
- Miri bath!
- Braid hair!
- Go biking at the park
- Library! South branch Berkeley library
Avi Help
- Take Avi for a stroll in the stroller
- Hold Avi while Sophie or Tal nap
- Do a ~2 hour night shift of "night nursing"
- Restock changing station and caddy
Sophie and Tal help
- Making
Projects
- Find a mother's helper
- Put up blackout curtains in Avi's room
- Art supply drawer organization (with Sophie giving directions)
- Anchor the toy shelf
- Develop Miri toys rotation plan and set it up (work with Tal or Sophie)
- Avi room setup (with Sophie)
- Set up "other kids" toys (with Sophie)
- Organize primary "Electronics" and "Tools" drawers (with Tal)
- Wiring cleanup and power strips (Miri's room, desk in guest room, Sophie's bed, LR)
- Set up low lighting in the living room (with Sophie)
- Pantry organization - think about cereal, ziploc bags, washing machine
- Kitchen - make space for Avi stuff!
- Hot tub towels - find a Sophie approved spot
